response.description:
In
addition to platform-level logs, Azure Container Apps now adds a dedicated
Azure Monitor diagnostic setting category, ContainerAppHTTPLogs,
that exposes detailed HTTP access logs for incoming traffic and is designed for
high-volume request data. With this capability, customers can now troubleshoot
ingress and request-flow issues with much greater precision, making it easier
to investigate failed requests, latency, retries, WebSocket disconnects,
routing behavior, and backend connectivity problems.  This
gives teams a dedicated, scalable traffic logging surface for scenarios where
platform-level signals alone were not enough to quickly understand
request-level behavior. The result is faster issue resolution, less operational
friction, and stronger confidence in running and scaling high-traffic,
business-critical applications on Azure Container Apps.  Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Monitor HTTP traffic in Azure Container Apps
